mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sp.plan_id) FROM lm_stability_plan_sample sp INNER JOIN lm_stability_inspect_plan p ON p.id = sp.plan_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_sample s ON s.id = sp.sample_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE

SELECT DISTINCT sp.plan_id FROM lm_stability_plan_sample sp INNER JOIN lm_stability_inspect_plan p ON p.id = sp.plan_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_sample s ON s.id = sp.sample_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ORDER BY sp.plan_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT sp.id AS overallSampleId, sp.plan_id AS planId, sp.batch_id AS batchId, sp.batch_no AS batchNo, sp.sample_id AS sampleId, sp.sample_no AS sampleNo, sp.actual_sample_amount AS actualSampleAmount, sp.sample_unit AS sampleUnit, sp.receive_date AS receiveDate, sp.receiver_name AS receiverName, sp.experiment_type AS experimentType, sp.storage_condition AS storageCondition, p.code AS planCode, p.material_id AS materialId, p.material_name AS materialName, p.material_code AS materialCode, p.material_spec AS materialSpec, p.create_by AS planCreateBy, p.create_time AS planCreateTime, p.start_date AS startDate, p.plan_end_date AS planEndDate, s.storage_location AS storageLocation, s.destroyed AS destroyed, s.current_quantity AS currentQuantity, s.process_time AS destroyTime, s.process_by AS destroyBy, s.process_remark AS destroyReason, sp.status AS sampleStatus FROM lm_stability_plan_sample sp INNER JOIN lm_stability_inspect_plan p ON p.id = sp.plan_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_sample s ON s.id = sp.sample_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sp.plan_id IN
#{pid}
AND sp.is_deleted = 0 AND sp.status IN ('RECEIVED', 'PENDING_DESTROY', 'DESTROYED') AND s.id IS NOT NULL
AND sp.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.batchNo}, '%')
AND sp.sample_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.sampleNo}, '%')
AND sp.status = #{query.status.value}
ORDER BY sp.plan_id DESC, sp.batch_id ASC, sp.id ASC

SELECT sp.sample_no AS sampleNo, sp.batch_no AS batchNo, sp.actual_sample_amount AS actualSampleAmount, sp.sample_unit AS sampleUnit, sp.sampling_time AS samplingTime, sp.sampler_name AS samplerName, sp.experiment_type AS experimentType, sp.storage_condition AS storageCondition, sp.receive_time AS receiveDate, p.code AS planCode, p.material_name AS materialName, p.material_code AS materialCode, p.material_spec AS materialSpec, s.storage_location AS storageLocation, b.production_date AS productionDate FROM lm_stability_plan_sample sp INNER JOIN lm_stability_inspect_plan p ON p.id = sp.plan_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_sample s ON s.id = sp.sample_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_stability_inspect_plan_batch b ON b.id = sp.batch_id AND b.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sp.sample_no = #{sampleNo} AND sp.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT s.sample_no AS sampleNo, b.batch_no AS batchNo, s.quantity AS actualSampleAmount, CAST(s.unit_id AS CHAR) AS sampleUnit, s.sampling_time AS samplingTime, s.sampler_name AS samplerName, t.experiment_type AS experimentType, t.storage_condition AS storageCondition, s.storage_location AS storageLocation, s.receive_time AS receiveDate, p.code AS planCode, p.material_name AS materialName, p.material_code AS materialCode, p.material_spec AS materialSpec, b.production_date AS productionDate FROM lm_sample s INNER JOIN lm_inspection_order o ON o.id = s.inspection_order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_plan_timepoint_task t ON t.inspection_order_id = o.id AND t.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_inspect_plan p ON p.id = t.plan_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_inspect_plan_batch b ON b.id = t.batch_id AND b.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.sample_no = #{sampleNo} AND s.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
